title: wbi-birds: epsilon-constraint harvest-bird-abundance tradeoff engine
description: Simulation engine for the WBI birds study: epsilon-constraint tradeoff analysis between even-flow harvesting and multi-species bird abundance in northeastern British Columbia timber supply areas, built on the ws3 forest-estate LP framework. Includes a species-generic bird anticipation module, eBird-derived ingestion, FreshForge workflow graphs, scenario runner, and a legacy-parity verification framework. Raw eBird data are not redistributed; derived products only.

creators.name: Paradis, Gregory
